title: Alone? Bend over the back of a chair 🪑
caption:
This could save your life one day 🫁
Save it. Share it. 👇
sources: American Red Cross, 'Conscious Choking' and self-help guidance (call 911, abdominal thrusts on yourself, or lean over a firm object such as a chair back)
NHS, 'What should I do if someone is choking?' (encourage coughing, back blows, abdominal thrusts; seek medical help after abdominal thrusts)
